title: Hydrophobic Material Absorption Test Station
description: A chemistry lab workstation where the user conducts a multi-step hydrophobic absorption experiment. The WaterBottle serves as a reagent dispenser that can be tilted to pour calibrated volumes of colored chemical solutions onto the SpecularSilkPouf, which acts as an experimental absorbent material sample. The user must follow a precise protocol: select reagents, calibrate pour volume, dispense onto the sample, measure absorption rate, and log results across multiple trials.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load SpecularSilkPouf.glb as an absorbent material sample placed on a lab bench surface (a flat box geometry with metallic grey material). Load WaterBottle.glb as a reagent dispenser positioned above-right of the pouf. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 5) looking at origin. Add a DirectionalLight from (5, 8, 5) with intensity 1.5, an AmbientLight at 0.4 intensity, and a PointLight near the bottle with soft blue tint. The background should be a dark lab color (#1a1a2e). Create an HTML overlay panel on the left side with: (1) a dropdown to select one of 4 reagents (Acid-red, Base-blue, Solvent-green, Catalyst-yellow), (2) a slider labeled 'Volume (mL)' ranging 10-100, (3) a 'Dispense' button, (4) a 'Measure Absorption' button, (5) a results log textarea. Interaction steps: Step 1 - User selects a reagent from dropdown. Step 2 - User adjusts volume slider (must be between 25-75 mL for valid results). Step 3 - User clicks Dispense; animate the WaterBottle tilting 45 degrees toward the pouf over 1 second using TWEEN or requestAnimationFrame lerp, and spawn small sphere particles in the selected reagent color falling from bottle mouth to pouf. Step 4 - The SpecularSilkPouf material color gradually blends toward the reagent color to simulate absorption. Step 5 - User clicks Measure Absorption; validate that volume was in range, calculate a mock absorption percentage (random 60-95% for valid volume, below 30% for invalid), display result in the log. Step 6 - User must repeat the full process for at least 2 different reagents. Track completed reagents in a Set. Step 7 - After 2+ unique reagents tested, show a 'Generate Report' button that compiles all logged results into a formatted summary in the textarea and triggers a celebratory particle burst above the scene. Validate each step: disable Measure until Dispense animation completes, disable Dispense until reagent is selected, disable Generate Report until 2+ unique trials logged. Add parameter validation warnings as red text if volume is outside 25-75 range.
